dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: One prominent closed 'O' structure on the right side exhibits a sharp gradient transition from a bright white-gray perimeter to a dark brown-black interior. Two adjacent 'C' shaped arcs in the central region show varying perimeter thickness, with the upper arc opening dorsally and the lower arc forming a near-complete ring.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid high-intensity pixel clusters is concentrated on the far left lateral flank, transitioning into more dispersed, larger blobs towards the dorsal midline.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent annuli in the mid-to-posterior section form a distinct obtuse triangle, with the longest edge oriented along the longitudinal axis of the body.
